lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A naming clause, moved from the chair, accepted without division because nobody on that floor can see a reason to object to a register.

lines.speaker: clerk_of_the_house
lines.text: Any perpetual counterparty must be named in the public register. That is all it says. It will hold up for three hundred years because it is boring.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: In my century there is a budget line that has been paid to a name for two hundred and eighty-one years, and the only reason the name is there at all is this afternoon.

lines.speaker: mara
lines.text: One clause. On a Thursday. You have just done in eleven minutes what I could not do in four years.
